title: Zesty Crisp Italian Beef Kidney Piadina
description: A fresh and crisp Italian dish featuring beef kidney, perfect for kids and adults alike, with a lamination-puff pastry and gluten-free friendly ingredients. This piadina is a delicious and easy to make meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the lamination puff pastry to a large rectangle, about 1/4 inch thick.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and cook the sliced beef kidney until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and chopped onion to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent, about 3 minutes.
Stir in the tomato sauce and bring to a simmer, cooking for an additional 2 minutes.
Spread the tomato sauce mixture over the center of the pastry rectangle, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Top the sauce with the shredded mozzarella cheese and chopped fresh basil.
Fold the edges of the pastry up over the filling, pressing gently to seal.
Brush the top of the pastry with a little bit of olive oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Bake the piadina in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and crispy.
